import threading
from collections import OrderedDict


class LRUCache:
    """
    A thread-safe Least Recently Used (LRU) cache implementation.
    
    This cache evicts the least recently used items when the capacity is exceeded.
    Thread safety is ensured using a reentrant lock (RLock) to protect all operations
    that access or modify the internal state.
    
    Time Complexity:
    - get(key): O(1) average case
    - put(key, value): O(1) average case
    
    Space Complexity:
    - O(capacity) for storing up
